articles.title: Blockchain researcher defends Ethereum Foundation, says it’s doing ‘exactly’ its job
articles.snippet: William Mougayar says critics are measuring the Ethereum Foundation by the wrong standard, claiming it was never meant to pump ETH or court institutions.
